missing: How many watts of solar panel actually keep a chest freezer going day to day in storm-season cloud (real vs rated panel output), a tested compressor-start and idle-draw check on the recommended units, and current street prices or codes for the 2–3 kWh units that cover 3 days.
why: No major reviewer or authority appears; every result is a small spec-math site, a forum anecdote, or an unreadable page. Six niche pages answer the 3-day runtime part with calculated figures nobody has tested, and only one (testedwatts) even names a solar-capable pick while admitting it does no lab testing. The solar half of the shopper's question is essentially unaddressed for a chest freezer. A focused page pairing a 3-day pick with a realistic solar panel sizing, current prices and tested codes would stand out, as our solar-kit win did against similar niche competition.
